summary: RETEST after CSV export None-handling fix. Ran the full existing pytest suite at /app/ross-house-backend/tests/test_tenant_waitlist.py against the deployed Railway backend (https://ross-house-backend-production.up.railway.app). Result: 18/18 PASS in 2.26s. The previously failing test_admin_export_csv now passes — endpoint returns HTTP 200 with content-type 'text/csv; charset=utf-8', proper Content-Disposition attachment header, and a valid CSV body containing the Spanish header row (Nombre, Email, Teléfono, Hab., Presupuesto, Mudanza, Personas, Mascotas, Empleo, Ingreso, Idioma, Estado, Prioridad, Notas, Creado) plus the QA lead row with '$0' rendered for the lead created without monthly_income — confirming the `(lead.get(key) or 0)` None-coalescing fix works. Sanity-checked public POST /api/public/tenant-leads (create + dedup) and admin GET /api/admin/tenant-leads (list + filter) — all green. No regressions.
seed_data_creation: Test fixture creates one QA lead per run with a timestamp-suffixed email (qa.lead.20260629+<ts>@example.com) and deletes it at the end of the admin test class. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tenant Waitlist (Lista de Espera) module is fully green on Railway. CSV export None-coalescing fix verified end-to-end. Test suite at /app/ross-house-backend/tests/test_tenant_waitlist.py is the canonical regression for this module — reuse it. JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter13_tenant_waitlist.xml.
rca_of_issue: Original bug (iter_12): GET /api/admin/tenant-leads/export/csv 500'd because the CSV row builder used `lead.get('monthly_income', 0)` / `lead.get('max_budget', 0)` — when the key existed but the stored value was None (legacy records / optional inputs), dict.get returned None, and the downstream f-string `f"${value:,.0f}"` then raised TypeError on a NoneType. Fix: switched to `(lead.get('monthly_income') or 0)` / `(lead.get('max_budget') or 0)`, coercing both 'missing' and 'present-but-None' to 0. Verified via direct curl: response 200, body contains '$0' for the income column where the QA fixture lead has no monthly_income. Mitigation already shipped to Railway.
